- **Definition**: A preprocessing function applied to volume data to restrict the range of density values, improving compression ratio by removing irrelevant data and avoiding discontinuities that generate high frequencies [S1, unofficial].

- **Step**: `shortsToBytes`: For each short $v$, write $(v \gg 8)$ as high byte, then $(v)$ as low byte to output array [S2, unofficial]. `bytesToShorts`: Check `data.length` is even.

- **Parameter**: $d_1, d_2, d_3, d_4$: Threshold parameters defining the density range $[d_2, d_3]$ to keep intact and the ramps $[d_1, d_2]$ and $[d_3, d_4]$ to avoid discontinuities [S1, unofficial].
cites no source with notes on this node

- **Step**: Apply function $T$ to each density value: if density $\le d_1$, set density $= 0$; if density $\ge d_3$, set density $= 0$; if $d_1 \le \text{density} \le d_2$, set density $= (\text{density} - d_1) \times d_2 / (d_2 - d_1)$; if $d_3 \le \text{density} \le d_4$, set density $= (d_3 - \text{density}) \times d_4 / (d_4 - d_3)$ [S1, unofficial].
cites no source with notes on this node

The concept of restricting density ranges to improve compression is described in the context of volumetric medical images visualization on mobile devices, where a function $T$ is used to filter density values before compression [S1, unofficial].
